## Hinge question · Reading the sum {#ss6-hinge .gs-lesson .sequence-hinge .gs-hinge}

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">Which expression correctly evaluates <span data-math="\displaystyle\sum_{k=2}^{6}3\cdot2^{k-1}">∑ from k = 2 to 6 of 3 · 2ᵏ⁻¹</span>?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="3(2^5-1)">3(2⁵ − 1)</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="6(2^4-1)">6(2⁴ − 1)</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="6(2^5-1)">6(2⁵ − 1)</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="3(2^6-1)">3(2⁶ − 1)</span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> First included term: <span data-math="3\cdot2^{2-1}=6">6</span>. Number of terms: <span data-math="6-2+1=5">5</span>.<br><span data-math="6+12+24+48+96=6(2^5-1)=186">6 + 12 + 24 + 48 + 96 = 186</span>.</div>
</div>
```

::: notes


Default 60 seconds with adjustable duration, start/pause/reset, and a separate answer reveal. Use simultaneous 1–4 fingers on the teacher's verbal cue. Correct answer 3: first included term 6, ratio 2, five terms. Choice 1 uses the coefficient 3 as the first term (93). Choice 2 counts 6−2=4 terms instead of 5 (90). Choice 4 sums from k=1 rather than k=2 (189). Timer expiry must not reveal the answer. Ready: explain both the 6 and the exponent 5. Divided: list indices 2,3,4,5,6 and re-poll. Reteach: substitute each index to get 6,12,24,48,96. Reset clears the choice, explanation and timer. This is a natural lesson split if teaching over two periods.

:::
